posts.title: Role play helps, heals and grounds
posts.description: OK... So you all know I'm the autistic kid, late diagnosed, living life screaming into the void. And you'll also know I don't do BS. I've been trying something. A role play in my head, mainly, poked around a bit by a friend. I'm playing out a part in an unscripted production, 24*7, as said an occasional poke from outside. It's weird, and working. posts.title: More disabled than you think
posts.description: I grew up 'odd', with learning delays. I grew up with chronic tick syndrome, which is for me an involuntary muscular tick where most of my muscles all over my body activate and deactivate at once, a muscle pulse in a fraction of a second.
